details:
I think this whole thing is awful

1. The avatar marketplace should NOT open BEFORE MY OWN AVATARS! That's insane! I have 0 intention of spending money in that way and it drives me mad having to spend the extra menu time getting to the avatars I actually use.

2. Spending money, why on gods green earth would I buy an avatar that gives 50% to the creator? not to mention that from all that I can tell I wouldn't even get the files. A 50 split just frankly is stupid and worthless when i could buy from booth or gumroad, give the creators 90%, and also get a superior product by getting the files.

I know the argument for this will be "convenience" but I just think there is a much better way to implement this that isn't such a giant middle finger to creators.

and im also sure that "oh the 50/50 split is necessary to blah blah blah" then dont do it.

If you cant respect the creators putting in the work for YOUR platform then dont implement a system that actively rips them off for the convenience of a few people who dont know better.

3. Overall I dont think the Idea itself is bad, I just think the execution is one of the worst things ive ever seen, I have independently asked my friends what they think of this and literally everyone I have spoken to hates it.

This entire update is fueled by greed, is poorly implemented, and is a giant middle finger to the creators who put hours and hours of work into making these works of art.
title: The Avatar Market Place is not well implemented and is a bad system.
